say:1:1110506001:1.text: It seems you guys have also passed the previous checkpoint.
say:1:1110506001:1.source_cn: 看来，你们也通过了刚才那一关。

say:3:1110506002:1.text: Nice to see you again, Seth! Looks like the winner of the Trial of Wisdom won't be decided so easily!
say:3:1110506002:1.source_cn: 又见面了，赛特斯大人！看来“智之试炼”的胜者还没那么容...

say:4:1110506003:1.text: Ha! If it was a race, you'd be toast by now.
say:4:1110506003:1.source_cn: 可笑。如果这是竞速淘汰，你们早已输了。

say:5:1110506004:1.text: Even working together as a group, you're all slower than me. What use is that teamwork of yours now, huh?
say:5:1110506004:1.source_cn: 一群乌合之众，过关的速度竟还不如我一个人。你们引以为傲...

say:7:1110506005:1.text: Being fast on your feet doesn't prove much.
say:7:1110506005:1.source_cn: 腿脚快些，也说明不了什么。

say:8:1110506006:1.text: Big words, pal. I hope your fists talk more than your mouth does.
say:8:1110506006:1.source_cn: 呵，嘴硬。希望你的拳头比嘴更硬。

say:9:1110506007:1.text: Let's continue. You should pray to the gods above that the next challenge doesn't require us to cross swords!
say:9:1110506007:1.source_cn: 继续前进吧。你们应当向残阳神祷告，下一关不必与我白刃相向！
